deadline_policy.rule: deadline = trace arrival + observed queue time + observed runtime
deadline_policy.interpretation: the original production completion time is used as the SLA proxy

memory.rule: pooled median observed GiB per GPU scheduling unit from Alibaba GPU v2023 and Acme Kalos
memory.freeze_timing: compute once after raw trace filtering/sharding and before any optimizer run

cpu.rule: pooled median observed CPU demand per GPU scheduling unit from Alibaba GPU v2023, Helios, and Acme
apply_to: Microsoft Philly and any row lacking CPU
cpu.note: CPU is retained for workload characterization but is not currently a formal hard constraint

bandwidth.reason: none of the four primary job traces provides a consistent per-job bandwidth request; bandwidth is not a current formal hard constraint

carbon_class.note: carbon-sensitivity class has no native equivalent across all four traces; sensitivity by class will be separate rather than inferred from hidden heuristics
